name: fear aura
desc:
Any creature hostile to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} that starts its turn within 20 feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must make a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw, unless the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is incapacitated. On a failed save, the creature is frightened until the start of its next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the creature is immune to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s Fear Aura for the next 24 hours.
Any creature hostile to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} that starts its turn within 20 feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must make a Wisdom saving throw.
